description.text: Forensic science is a discipline that integrates natural sciences such as medicine, biology and chemistry with social sciences like law and criminal investigation. It aims to study and solve medical problems involved in legal practice through scientific and technological means. Its core task is to apply medical theories and technologies to examine and identify human bodies (including corpses and living organisms) and biological materials related to law, providing scientific evidence for judicial decisions, criminal investigations, civil disputes, etc.Forensic science covers corpses, living organisms, and physical evidence (such as blood, hair, body fluids, etc.). Its research content includes causes of death, time of death, injury mechanisms, individual identification, paternity testing, toxicological analysis, etc. It serves as a key bridge connecting medicine and law and plays an irreplaceable role in maintaining judicial justice, combating crimes, and resolving medical disputes.

duration.text: The Forensic medicine at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.
